# Cristhobal Canales

> Fullstack Web Developer from Chile. Builds web systems for public
> institutions, administrative platforms, modern UIs and custom FiveM
> server scripts using Astro, React, TypeScript and Node.js.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to help
AI agents and assistants navigate and summarize this site accurately.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.cristhobal.cl/): Summary, featured projects, work
  experience, education and tech stack.
- [Projects](https://www.cristhobal.cl/projects): Full list of open-source
  and private projects, searchable, with tech tags and descriptions.
- [Experience](https://www.cristhobal.cl/experience): Full professional
  timeline — roles, companies and responsibilities.

## Notes for agents

- Content is server-rendered static HTML (Astro, `output: "static"`); no
  login or JavaScript execution is required to read page content.
- The visible language on first load defaults to English; a client-side
  script swaps text to the visitor's browser language (en, es, fr, zh, hi)
  without changing the URL. All language variants describe the same
  content — treat them as one canonical page per path.
- Canonical URLs and per-page `<title>`/`<meta name="description">` are
  present in the static HTML and should be treated as authoritative.
